'''Blizz''' was the nickname of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who traveled with the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Blizz, like all Jawas, was born on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but eventually Blizz and his clan were recruited by the traveling salvager [[Slam Streever]] to work as "ferrets"&mdash;individuals he could send into dangerous areas to scout for valuable salvage. Streever gave the Jawa the nickname "Blizz" after he kicked up a small snowstorm out of excitement upon first seeing the "white sands" on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. While on Hoth, Blizz and the salvage gang worked for the [[White Maw]] pirate [[Reneget Vause]], until a fellow Jawa [[Jreely Toomb]] told their foreman that Blizz was stealing salvage under his coat, which resulted in Blizz being kicked out. He was imprisoned by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Ascendancy]] in the [[Dorn Base]] but repeatedly escaped from his cell.

While imprisoned, Blizz assisted the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] in hunting down Reneget Vause, a blacklist [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]]. As Vause viewed the Champion to be unworthy to fight, Blizz advised the Champion to take down Vause's [[Captain/Legends|captains]] to prove their worthiness. Afterwards, the Hunter persuaded Warden [[Khel]] to let Blizz join his crew. With the help of [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] he was able to track down Jreely and get most of his things back from him by sneaking into the White Maw camp and proceeding to act like Jreely, as the pirates couldn't tell the difference. Blizz also beat up Jreely, getting over his fear of him.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] in [[3636 BBY]], the Champion went missing. During the following five years in their absence, Blizz became his own bounty hunter and scavenger, reuniting with Jreely and forming his own crew out of Jawas. Five years after the Champions disappearance, Blizz and his crew were given a job contract from a [[Languss Tuno|person]] who only identified as a Jedi. Though Blizz was suspicious by his non-Jedi attitude and constantly correcting himself, Blizz took the job offer to find an old [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]. During the search, his "white-sand crawler" was damaged by the White Maw pirates. While working on repairs, Blizz was approached by [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]], who wanted to recruit Blizz into their [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Throne]]. Blizz agreed to help if the Outlander help Blizz with his crawler and his mission. After the Outlander helped with repairs, they gathered a team of Jawas to steal the holoprojector from the "[[Ugnaught/Legends|Ug-men]]." Blizz and the Outlander recovered the holoprojector and Blizz sent it to the "Jedi-man". Afterward, Blizz and his crew traveled to Odessen to join the Outlander's Alliance.<ref name="Little Boss" />

Blizz later overheard the Outlander and the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] [[Sana-Rae]] discussing a vision the latter had had involving a Force-sensitive individual who matched the description of the "Jedi-man". He then accompanied the Outlander to meet with the "Jedi-man" on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]—who was revealed to actually be former Jedi Padawan Languss "Guss" Tuno. While the Outlander accompanied Guss in order to help him complete a trial assigned by his master, [[Isaac (Human)|Isaac]], Blizz aided Isaac in fixing his ice box, for which he was rewarded with [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]], and wound up very drunk. When Guss and the Outlander returned looking for Isaac, a drunk Blizz took them to meet with him in the [[Slippery Slopes Cantina]], where he then proceeded to watch the [[South Sector Boppers]] perform while Isaac and the Outlander discussed the trial and offered to have Guss join the Alliance.<ref name="Shining in the Darkness">{{TORcite|type=general|Shining in the Darkness|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
His primary weapon was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and utilize a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] for defense and a shoulder-mounted [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] for ultra-offense. Blizz loved to go on adventures, make new friends, and be the center of attention. He disliked violence and mean people.

==Behind the scenes==
Blizz is a companion character for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] class of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Art of TOR">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> He later becomes available to all classes during the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion, where he can optionally be recruited during the Alliance Alert, "Little Boss".<ref name="Little Boss" /> If he is recruited, he will again show up during the Alliance Alert, "Shining in the Darkness", where the player can recruit his employer, who is revealed to be Guss Tuno, a companion character originally for the Smuggler class.<ref name="Shining in the Darkness" />
